---
title: '20260601'
version: 0.56.0
date: 2026-06-01
description: More ACP agents including Grok Build and a MiniMax preset, history-conflict re-import, correct model and thinking level in conversations, email sign-in for feedback.lody.ai, and a batch of mobile fixes.
---
### New

- Added more ACP agents, such as Grok Build, plus a MiniMax preset.
- On a history conflict, you can now re-import with the ACP-side history taking priority.
- Conversations now show the correct model name and thinking level.
- feedback.lody.ai now supports email sign-in.

### Fixes and Improvements

- Fixed first-launch failures for codex and Claude Code caused by a stale npx cache.
- Reduced stutter when reconnecting after a dropped connection on mobile.
- Local project branch information no longer refreshes too frequently.
- Fixed user messages overflowing the screen on mobile.
- Improved GitHub project avatar caching.
- Improved the mobile back-gesture trigger.
- Fixed a broken back-navigation animation on mobile.
- Fixed restore and permanent delete for archived conversations on mobile.
- Improved the theme picker interaction.
